name: City Council Special Meeting - Workshop
agenda_text:
To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to be
called to order in the Margate Room at the Palos Verdes Golf Club, located at 3301 Via Campesina,
Palos Verdes Estates, CA at 9:00 a.m. on Thursday, May 24, 2018. The agenda for the special
meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Friday, May 18, 2018, at 5:00 p.m.

  May 24, 2018
  9:00 a.m.
  Palos Verdes Golf Club – Margate Rm
  3301 Via Campesina
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request
a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the City Council meetings;
however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make
a presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes or as specified by the Mayor. Anyone wishing
to address the City Council is requested to fill out a speaker’s card that is available in the meeting
room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minutes
preparation.

The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the
order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future City Council
meetings.

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R18-30

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O18-734

 CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL (9:00 AM)

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM(S)
This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the
matters listed below pursuant to Government Codes §54957. The Mayor or City Attorney will
give an additional oral report regarding the closed session.

  i.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Government Code §54957
  Title: City Manager

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION (10:00 AM)

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT
At the conclusion of the closed session, the Council may continue any item listed on the closed
session agenda to the open session agenda for discussion or to take formal action as it may
deem appropriate.

NEW BUSINESS

  1. Review of Agenda

  Purpose: To review the objectives and goals of the meeting.

  2. Discussion of Lessons Learned from Measure E Election

  Purpose: To discuss observations during the election process.

  3. Discussion of Building Trust and Partnerships with the Community

  Purpose: To discuss ideas and an action plan for the upcoming year.

  4. Discussion of Staff, Committees, and Elected Official’s Roles

  Purpose: To discuss the roles and interactions among staff, committees and elected
  officials for accomplishing the City Council’s goals.

  5. Next Steps; Discussion of City Council and Staffing Goals and Achievements

  Purpose: To discuss the status and achievements in support of the City Council’s goals
  and next steps for moving forward for accomplishing goals and objectives.

 ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, MAY 30, 2018, AT 9:00 A.M. IN THE COUNCIL
CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A WORKSHOP.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing
agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to
Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos
Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in
accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 18th day of May 2018.
  Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
